grounding.exactText: - Executive marketing leader with 20+ years of experience driving commercial scale, digital transformation and customer-centric innovation across leading automotive, healthcare and consumer organizations.

- Proven success building high-performing teams, leading multi-million-dollar portfolios and delivering measurable commercial outcomes through brand strategy, customer experience, enterprise MarTech and data-driven marketing.
- Commercial Leadership: Building & Scaling GCCs, P&L Management, Strategic Pitches
- Growth & Performance Marketing: Full-Funnel Acquisition, ROAS Optimization, Conversion Strategy
- Brand & Customer Strategy: Integrated Marketing, PR, Consumer Insights, Content Strategy
- Digital Transformation & MarTech: Salesforce CDP, Adobe Experience Cloud, CRM & Customer Lifecycle
- Analytics & Experimentation: O2O Attribution, KPI Frameworks, A/B and Multivariate Testing
- Innovation & AI: GenAI Automation, Digital Commerce, Marketing Innovation

- Accountable for commercial performance, delivery and profitability of VML India's two largest client accounts, overseeing an $8M pure agency fee book for Ford and a projected ₹36 Cr 3-year service retainer for BMW.
- Recruited and managed a 40-member cross-functional Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (GCC) driving CRM, website & performance marketing across 13 APAC and Middle East markets for Ford.
Concurrently led a complex legacy-to-Salesforce CRM migration across these regions within a 12-month timeline.
- Established a Digital Analytics & Experimentation Lab, embedding A/B testing into client and agency decision-making, enabling faster optimization and improved marketing effectiveness.
- Redesigned customer journeys across digital platforms, improving lead quality and reducing friction in the booking and enquiry process, resulting in $14M in attributed additional revenue.
- Won and led the integrated mainline, digital, and PR mandates for BMW India and 22 dealers, taking full ownership of brand architecture and integrated messaging.

- Spearheaded the "Drive Your Match" campaign and core social strategies that supported BMW becoming India’s highest-selling Auto OEM in Q1’26, earning formal recognition from India CEO Harpreet Brar and global leadership.
- Selected to lead the Centrum portfolio following WPP's 2025 global Haleon win, assuming overall strategic and commercial leadership for this high-growth mandate.
- Leading integrated marketing, social and commerce strategy for Centrum and Recharge as part of WPP's global Haleon partnership.
- Built and scaled a hyperlocal digital marketing program across 4,000+ dealerships, generating more than 400,000 additional organic qualified leads leveraging AI and NLP in regional languages.
- Engineered the implementation of Salesforce CDP to map customer journeys and optimize long-term retention across the premium and electric vehicle portfolios.
- Orchestrated digital-first product launches, including India’s first premium vehicle launch in the metaverse for the Rider and an exclusive e-commerce-only launch for the iQube.
- Grew Ford's digital revenue contribution from 3% to over 32% in five years through integrated performance marketing and digital commerce initiatives.
- Collaborated directly with Google engineering teams to build a 'Global First' Online-to-Offline (O2O) Attribution model to quantify how digital engagement impacted physical retail transactions.
- Executed purpose-driven PR campaigns like the 'Cartesy' safety platform, which won more than 20 marketing honors and successfully shifted market perceptions on cost-of-ownership.
- Introduced new digital acquisition channels, including flash sales on Amazon and online booking journeys that expanded lead generation opportunities.
- Owned end-to-end brand-building, product marketing, and growth architecture across key internet properties, including INLEAD and iHealthcare.
- Outperformed baseline commercial and lead acquisition targets for 3 successive fiscal cycles by up to 14%.
- Shifted marketing investments towards measurable performance channels, reducing customer acquisition costs by 70%.
- Developed localized 360-degree digital acquisition campaigns, capturing S$1.8M in net new pipeline from corporate targets within 6 months.
- Managed an 80 Million INR marketing mix, leading to a 26% increase in customer conversions during an industry downturn.
- Pioneered early organic search and optimization frameworks, executing some of the earliest Google AdWords and targeted SMS outreach campaigns in 2006.
